correctness.rationale: The three independent character modulations normalize a00=a10=a01=1 uniquely, leaving exactly q^6 distinct arrays. Character orthogonality gives ∫|P|^6=Σ_{r,s}|[z^r w^s]P^3|². Counting 3-term frequency multisets with exact multinomial coefficients and cyclotomic norms (C0−C1)^2 for q=2, or (C0−C2)^2−(C0−C2)(C1−C2)+(C1−C2)^2 for q=3, produces only integer arithmetic. Independently enumerated ALL 64+729 normalized cases, finding minimum 1641 with 4 normalized binary optimizers, minimum 1197 with 2 ternary cubic Fourier optimizers, moment spectra with 19 and 63 values. Labelled multiplier-orbit sizes are exactly q^3. This exhaustive enumeration is a proof of the finite-domain global optimum; no arbitrary unit phases are covered.
